rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for strongly wanting something, especially food or an action.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 soeng2 sik6 siu1 ngo2

rows.note: Use this for intense, often more abstract yearning such as craving peace, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dou1 hot3 mong6 sai3 gaai3 wo4 ping4
